description: This file provides utilities for SSH sandbox management, including creating SSH sessions from configurations or settings, running SSH commands, uploading directories via SSH, and handling SSH session cleanup. It includes functions for building SSH commands, handling secrets, and managing SSH configuration files.

methods.name: function normalizeInlineSshMaterial(contents: string, filename: string): string { normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH material contents by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and handling special cases for identity or certificate files.

methods.name: function buildSshFailureMessage(stderr: string, exitCode?: number): string { buildSshFailureMessage
methods.description: Creates a user-friendly failure message based on SSH stderr output and exit code.

methods.name: export function shellEscape(value: string): string { shellEscape
methods.description: Escape a string for safe use in shell commands.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a remote command string from an array of arguments with proper shell escaping.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a shell command string to execute another command with optional working directory and environment variables.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for invoking SSH with specific session parameters.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH session based on provided configuration text, saving the config file in a temporary directory.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Creates an SSH session from given settings, generating SSH config file with appropriate options and keys.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Removes the temporary directory used for the SSH session.

methods.name: runSshSandboxCommand
methods.description: Executes an SSH command in the sandboxed environment, capturing output and handling errors.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryToSshTarget
methods.description: Uploads a local directory to a remote SSH target via tar over SSH, ensuring use of safe symlinks.

methods.name: assertSafeUploadSymlinks
methods.description: Recursively verifies that symlinks in a directory do not escape the root directory.
